description: @cloudlet/toast: a notification toaster for React 18 and 19 and Next.js. One stack that collapses to a pill and morphs into the Island; operations that follow a promise with progress, retry and cancel; forms inside a notification; accessible, SSR-safe and strict-CSP friendly.
rules: Import '@cloudlet/toast/styles.css' once, create one controller with createCloudlet() and render <Toaster /> inside <CloudletProvider controller={...}>.
Get the controller with useCloudlet() and call show, update, dismiss or track from event handlers or effects, never during render.
In the Next.js App Router a 'use client' owner component creates the controller in an effect and disposes that same instance in the effect's cleanup.
On the server create one controller per request and dispose it after the response; never share a controller between requests.
Use cloudlet.track(promiseOrFactory, options) for async work; pass a factory ({ signal }) => ... to make the operation retryable and cancellable.
Dismissing a tracked notification never aborts its operation; call cancel() on the operation handle to stop the work.
